Care Credit. Cherry. I financed mine through Cherry. Super easy. Soft pull on your credit.
Reply
Share
View 5 replies
Andrea Tuttle-Watkins
 
·
1w
It depends on which financing partners your surgeon works with. There are PatientFi, CareCredit, Cherry and Alphaeon used most in plastics. I used PatientFi to help with part of mine. Great terms, high approvals, easy payments and good customer service. Depending what your surgeons accept for programs, there are 6-24 month no interest options and longer term with interest.
I’ll add to that 11 years ago when I was younger I took out a HELOC for my skin removal surgeries after 110 lb weight loss because at that time in life I couldn’t pay it off within a zero percent interest timeframe. The HELOC was under 4% interest at the time and interest was tax deductible so it was the best option for me at the time.
Reply

Some people take a loan from their 401k plan. This is not a withdrawal but a loan if your 401k plan allows for that. Low interest rates plus you are paying yourself back on your loan back into your 401k plan. Better than a loan or card to take out where the money goes back to them and not you.
